lines.zh: 根须从土里拔出，慢慢挪。
lines.en: My roots pull free of the soil and shuffle along.

lines.zh: 我拖着花盆似的身体走。
lines.en: I drag my pot-like body forward.
My cyan petals sway along the path.
I wobble each step, as if the wind pushes me.
Soil trails behind me along the road.

lines.zh: 我找到有阳光的地方就走。
lines.en: I walk toward wherever the sunlight falls.
My stalk holds me up, swaying badly.

lines.zh: 我挪到草丛边，停下喘气。
lines.en: I shuffle to the grass edge and pause to breathe.

lines.zh: 花瓣擦过叶片，声音很轻。
lines.en: My petals brush the leaves with a faint sound.
I pick soft soil for each footfall.

lines.zh: 走得慢，但我不想被踩到。
lines.en: I go slowly; I don't want to be stepped on.

lines.zh: 我绕过石头，继续往前移。
lines.en: I round a stone and keep shifting forward.
I stand still and simply open my petals.

lines.zh: 太阳偏了一点，我跟着转。
lines.en: The sun shifts, and I turn with it.

lines.zh: 我不动，蜜蜂也不敢靠近。
lines.en: I stay still, and even the bees keep away.

lines.zh: 露水从花瓣尖上滚下来。
lines.en: Dew rolls off the tips of my petals.
I press my roots a little deeper.
The wind comes, and I sway all over.

lines.zh: 有人在看我，我装作是花。
lines.en: Someone is watching; I pretend to be a flower.

lines.zh: 青色的花瓣一片片数过去。
lines.en: I count my cyan petals one by one.
There is an old scar on my stalk.
I fold my petals and curl into a bud.

lines.zh: 根须一碰到湿泥，我就放松了。
lines.en: As soon as my roots touch damp soil, I relax.
I open slowly, then close slowly.
The tall grass hides half of me.
I count the light patches and wait for the cloud.
I feel dry, so I give myself a shake.
I lean over as if I might topple any moment.
My roots turn gently in the soil.

lines.zh: 周围太吵，我缩了缩花瓣。
lines.en: It is too noisy; I pull my petals in.

lines.zh: 你的影子落下来，我的花瓣合了一点。
lines.en: Your shadow falls and my petals close a little.
I lift a petal and take one look at you.
Don't come closer; I will start trembling.
You are standing on my root.
I turn my face toward you, very slowly.
Are you going to pick me? I'm not pretty.

lines.zh: 青色的花瓣对着你张开。
lines.en: My cyan petals open toward you.
I am in your shadow; it is cooler here.

lines.zh: 你袖口沾着湿土，我闻出来了。
lines.en: There is damp earth on your cuff. I can tell.

lines.zh: 你手里那片青色，比我还绿。
lines.en: That cyan thing in your hand is greener than I am.

lines.zh: 你一靠近，我就想变成曼陀罗。
lines.en: Come closer and I may turn into a mandrake.
I won't run. I am only a flower.
Ow, a petal came off.
Don't touch my stalk; it will snap.
I curl up tight; it hurts.
The soil has been shaken loose.
My color has faded a little.
You stepped on me and it hurt.
My roots are shaking; I can't stop them.
A little sap seeps out of me.
I lie on the ground and cannot push up.
I need a moment to recover.
Is that water? My roots are drying out.
I lean toward the light.

lines.zh: 你把土松一松，我就长好。
lines.en: Loosen the soil and I will grow better.

lines.zh: 烂叶子在我身下化成水。
lines.en: Rotten leaves melt to water beneath me.
Will that make me bloom?
I stretch my stalk, trying to reach it.

lines.zh: 别把水倒太急，会冲坏根。
lines.en: Don't pour too fast; it will wash out my roots.
I shuffle half a step, then lose my nerve.
Every petal is pointing at you now.
I only want a little sunlight, honestly.
Ah, my petals are crushed.
You knocked me tilting to one side.
The soil scatters from under my roots.
Don't crowd me; I have only one stalk.
I fall over, then push myself up.
A petal came off. That hurts.

lines.zh: 你身上的风把我吹歪了。
lines.en: The air around you bends me over.
I bump your leg; it is hard.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，花粉乱飞。
lines.en: We bump, and pollen scatters.
Slow down; I bruise easily.

lines.zh: 花粉飘过去，落在你身上。
lines.en: Pollen drifts over and settles on you.

lines.zh: 我朝同类的方向摇花瓣。
lines.en: I sway my petals toward my own kind.

lines.zh: 两朵花靠在一起，很安静。
lines.en: Two flowers lean together, very quiet.
I release a faint scent.
Our roots have tangled under the soil.
Don't interrupt; we are pollinating.
My petal rests against your hand.
I lean in slowly, afraid to bruise.

lines.zh: 风把我们的香气混在一起。
lines.en: The wind mixes our scents together.
I bloom brighter than usual.

lines.zh: 我卷起一片叶子接住它。
lines.en: I curl a leaf to catch it.
If it falls at my feet, it is mine.
My roots press it into the loose soil.

lines.zh: 花瓣兜住了这颗小东西。
lines.en: A petal cradles this little thing.
I will keep it; maybe it will bloom.

lines.zh: 我低头把它含在花心里。
lines.en: I bend down and tuck it into my flower's heart.
This bit of soil is useful to me.

lines.zh: 这枚落在花瓣上，归我保管。
lines.en: This fell onto my petals, so I keep it.
I hold it up, afraid the wind will take it.
I set it carefully beside my roots.
You stepped over here. I noticed.
I pull in my petals and mark you.
My roots tense, ready to flee.
Your hand moved. I saw it.
Don't pick me; I will scream.
I turn toward the other side.
If I move, you will spot me.
One of my petals twitches.

lines.zh: 你的靴尖快碰到我的茎了。
lines.en: Your boot tip is nearly on my stalk.
I shrink back into the grass.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脚，随时要躲。
lines.en: I watch your feet, ready to dodge.
You take a step; I shift an inch.
I close my petals and pass for dry weeds.

lines.zh: 青色的花瓣跟着你一起转。
lines.en: My cyan petals turn along with you.
My roots have already dug a way out.
I count how much closer you are.
The moment you move, I know.
I don't cry out; I wait for a chance.
The grass is too short to hide me.
I hold my stalk taut and dare not relax.

lines.zh: 我用花瓣啪地拍你一下。
lines.en: I slap you with a petal.
My stalk whips across your leg.
I throw my whole bloom at you.
My roots wrap around your ankle.
Don't think a flower cannot fight back.
This blow is light, but it stings.
Pollen goes right into your face.

lines.zh: 拍完那一下，我立刻退回去。
lines.en: After the slap I retreat at once.
My petal's edge caught you.

lines.zh: 我只是护着我的根，不是要伤你。
lines.en: I only guard my roots; I don't mean to hurt you.

lines.zh: 土裂开，我从里面钻出来。
lines.en: The soil cracks, and I push up through it.

lines.zh: 一朵青色的花，忽然会动了。
lines.en: A cyan flower, suddenly moving.
I open my eyes to a world of green.

lines.zh: 露水落在新长的花瓣上。
lines.en: Dew lands on my new petals.
The sunlight is good here; I take root.
I poke out from between the grass roots.
Just sprouted, I can hardly stand.
I shake off the clumps of dirt.
The flowers around me say nothing.
I open my first petal.

lines.zh: 土里的养分刚好够我醒。
lines.en: The soil held just enough to wake me.

lines.zh: 谁在这里走过？草被压了。
lines.en: Who walked here? The grass is flattened.

lines.zh: 火舌卷过来，花瓣一下就焦了。
lines.en: Flame licks over and my petals scorch at once.

lines.zh: 掉下去的时候，根全摔断了。
lines.en: As I fell, my roots snapped.

lines.zh: 水泡着我的根，它们开始烂。
lines.en: Water soaks my roots, and they begin to rot.

lines.zh: 炸开的气浪把我整朵掀翻。
lines.en: The blast flips my whole bloom over.

lines.zh: 有个东西穿透了我的花瓣。
lines.en: Something pierced clean through my petal.

lines.zh: 紫色的光一照，我的茎就枯了。
lines.en: Violet light touches me and my stalk withers.

lines.zh: 晒不到太阳，我越来越软。
lines.en: With no sunlight I grow weaker and softer.

lines.zh: 脚下的土没了，根悬空乱抓。
lines.en: The soil is gone; my roots claw at nothing.
